review.description: Runtime additionally checks updated>=created and review_id===approval.approval_id. Review disposition is Portal-only, never upstream promotion.

oneOf.description: Runtime additionally checks unique panel_id/panel_kind/panel ordinal/finding_id and finding.panel_id membership. Empty retained arrays do not assert source completeness. No prose/URLs/actors/financial values or private integrity preimages.

PaperExitParentReadV2.description: Finite current-authorized Paper Exit. Current stored bytes verified for integrity, not historical source acceptance. Optional sections require their own exact current reviewed field purposes. No raw capture/preimage/private intent/prose is returned.

approval.description: Portal timestamps, not source freshness. Runtime additionally checks updated/expires/SLA/nonnull decided >= created. Historical planning expiry does not expire current-authorized read.

R2ParentReadV2.description: Finite current-authorized Portal R2 parent. Stored lineage is historical reference, never an effective TS grant, current R1 permission, source acceptance or dispatch. No prose, actors or monetary values.

OperationalIncidentCurrentV2.description: Current Portal root only; target/env/version rechecked before final authority. Forward target guard never attests old annotations/evidence/links/actors or counts. MITIGATED/RESOLVED are local triage, not broker safety. Runtime additionally enforces finite ordered dates and lifecycle timestamp shape.

OperationalWorkflowV2.description: Actual immutable workspace/id/key/target/environment/source queue-F0 join, not inferred family. provenance_basis distinguishes exact SQL timestamp copy from the existing writer's historical JS Date millisecond truncation (not arbitrary tolerance); historical bytes are not rewritten. Different author with full exact current audit is allowed; explicit F0 routes retain their own-author ceiling. Runtime additionally enforces operation ids equal; original planning expiry is not read expiry.

OperationalQueueV2.description: Counts are scoped BEFORE filters/page/sort/edge probes to current supported audit tuples. Nonzero authority with zero rows is EMPTY; no authority is404. Runtime additionally enforces total>=filtered>=page rows, exact read_truth, and has_more/previous iff their opaque cursor is nonnull. Bound1MiB. No ADMIN/read_all/creator bypass or actor/prose/incident/source journal disclosure.

OperationalQueueItemV2.description: Finite immutable Portal labels plus current local triage, not TS execution. Runtime additionally enforces nonnegative finite dates, updated>=created and the existing triage/timestamp shape. SQL retains six fractional UTC digits for exact keyset boundaries.

F0CommandCollection.description: Finite current-actor F0 intent history for one exact resource/environment. At most1024 matching own intents are censused;1025 refuses explicitly. Pages sort created_at descending then operation_id ASCII ascending. Runtime additionally enforces returned_count===items.length, items.length<=limit, unique ids and has_more iff next_cursor is nonnull. No global count, source status, relay or dispatch. Portal timestamps are not source freshness.

F0BlockedOperationRead.title: Finite current-authorized F0 blocked intent
F0BlockedOperationRead.description: Same twelve-field execution.command-operation.v1 body, no source status or dispatch. Stored target is requested intent, not TS attestation. created_at and updated_at are Portal timestamps, not source freshness. Runtime additionally enforces nonnegative finite epochs and updated_at >= created_at.

TypedCondition.$comment: expires_at must be on or after deadline when both values are non-null; enforced by the application semantic validator

payload.$comment: Application validator enforces HASH_ONLY_NO_RAW storage, max 32768 UTF-8 bytes, depth 6, 512 nodes, 128 array items, 4096-character strings, and forbidden sensitive key fragments

read_truth.description: Truth for the exact server-bound queue request. EMPTY does not assert that a workspace has no operations outside the requested filters or opaque cursor.
